title: Chapter 2 Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of the Unreal Editor interface, viewport controls, content browser, scene management, and customisation.

questions.question: Which panel is the main window for viewing and navigating your 3D world?
questions.explanation: The Viewport is the central 3D window where you build and explore your level.

questions.question: How can you restore a panel you accidentally closed?
questions.explanation: All panels can be re‑opened from the Window menu at the top of the editor.

questions.question: Dragging a panel tab lets you dock it to a new location.
questions.explanation: Panels are fully dockable. Drag a tab to reposition or stack it.

questions.question: Hold the _____ key while flying in the viewport to speed up camera movement.
questions.explanation: Holding Shift increases camera speed; Ctrl reduces it.

questions.question: Which view mode displays only polygon edges?
questions.explanation: Wireframe shows geometry edges and is useful for optimisation checks.

questions.question: What is the shortcut to focus the camera on a selected object?
questions.explanation: Pressing F while an object is selected instantly moves the camera to frame it.

questions.question: Game View (G) hides editor icons to simulate the player’s perspective.
questions.explanation: Game View removes editor helpers like icons and bounding boxes, giving a clean in‑game view.

questions.question: What does the Content Browser represent?
options: The project's /Content folder and all its assets
questions.explanation: It mirrors the /Content folder where all user‑created and imported assets reside.

questions.question: Which file format is commonly used for importing 3D models?
questions.explanation: FBX is the standard interchange format for 3D models and animations.

questions.question: What is a Collection in the Content Browser?
options: A real folder that stores files
A virtual group of asset references
questions.explanation: Collections dynamically reference assets from any location without moving them.

questions.question: To filter the Content Browser to show only materials, click the _____ icon.
questions.explanation: The funnel icon opens the filter menu, allowing you to display specific asset types.

questions.question: The World Outliner shows all assets in your entire project.
questions.explanation: The World Outliner lists only actors placed in the current level. Assets are in the Content Browser.

questions.question: What happens when you drag Actor A onto Actor B in the World Outliner?
options: A becomes a child of B
questions.explanation: Dragging one actor onto another creates a parent‑child hierarchy.

questions.question: In the Details Panel, a yellow property value means:
questions.explanation: Yellow indicates a non‑default value; blue is the default.

questions.question: Selecting multiple actors lets you edit their common properties simultaneously.
questions.explanation: The Details Panel shows shared properties when multiple actors are selected, allowing bulk edits.

questions.question: To save your custom panel arrangement, use Window → _____ Layout.
questions.explanation: Save Layout stores your current panel configuration for reuse.

questions.question: What is the difference between Editor Preferences and Project Settings?
options: Editor Preferences affect only the current editor session
Editor Preferences are per‑user, Project Settings are per‑project
questions.explanation: Editor Preferences are local to your machine; Project Settings are saved inside the project and shared.

questions.question: Which shortcut duplicates the selected actor?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+D creates a duplicate instantly. Ctrl+C/V is copy/paste.

questions.question: Which key cycles between Move, Rotate, and Scale tools?
questions.explanation: Pressing Spacebar cycles through the transformation widgets.

questions.question: What does the Command Palette (Ctrl+P) do?
options: Allows you to search and run any editor command by name
questions.explanation: The Command Palette is a quick launcher for any editor action.

questions.question: Press _____ to toggle Game View and hide editor icons.
questions.explanation: G toggles between Editor View and Game View.

questions.question: The Content Browser’s search bar can filter by asset type as well as name.
questions.explanation: You can type type:material or use the funnel filter to show only certain asset types.

questions.question: Which viewport option lets you see collision shapes?
questions.explanation: The Show dropdown has a Collision checkbox that visualizes collision geometry.

questions.question: What is the shortcut to save all modified assets?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+Shift+S triggers Save All, ensuring every dirty asset is written to disk.
